name: How long does it take to install an accessible kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an accessible kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for an accessible kitchen sink can range from a few hours to a full day, depending on the scope of work. A straightforward replacement with minor plumbing adjustments might be completed within half a day. However, if countertop modifications, significant plumbing re-routing to create knee space, or custom cabinetry work are required, the process could extend to a full day or even longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes a few hours to a full day, depending on the complexity of plumbing modifications, countertop adjustments, and cabinet work.
